summary: Per-frame update of a scrollable UI component. Invokes a vtable update first, reads current selection/scroll references from the dual-field object at this+0x40, advances a float accumulator (this+0x108), then dispatches scroll behavior on the scroll state (this+0x104): recompute item layout and move a bounded counter (state 1), step the counter (states 2/3), clamp and apply a scroll delta (state 4), or step-scroll via sub_47BB40 (state 5). Always ends by invoking a vtable refresh and returning its result.
